## Problem
The `verify-identity (whole-store authorship gate)` job in `.github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml` fetches the full `tickets` branch (`git fetch --filter=blob:none`) and fails closed if the resulting pack exceeds `REBAR_TICKETS_PACK_LIMIT_KIB` (131072 KiB = 128 MiB). As of 2026-08-04 the tickets pack measures **131830 KiB**, ~758 KiB (0.6%) over the limit, so the gate casts **Verified -1**.

This blocks EVERY Gerrit change (repo-wide), not any one change's code. First observed on change 1385 (ad85), whose own pytest/lint/typecheck jobs all pass.

## Why history cannot be truncated
The gate deliberately mounts FULL tickets history for commit-ancestry era scoping (ADR 0051; the append-only event log is authorship-critical). So the pack only grows monotonically; compaction/truncation is not an option.

## Options
1. Bump `REBAR_TICKETS_PACK_LIMIT_KIB` in `.github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml` with headroom (e.g. 196608 KiB / 192 MiB) — the durable fix. NOTE: this is a fail-closed abuse/size guard on a security gate; the bump should be deliberate and reviewed.
2. Server-side gc/repack of the origin tickets branch may reclaim a little delta space (one-time, GitHub-controlled; unreliable).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `REBAR_TICKETS_PACK_LIMIT_KIB` raised with justified headroom, OR an equivalent durable mechanism agreed.
- [ ] A fresh Gerrit change passes the `verify-identity` whole-store gate (Verified +1).
